Fine mineral grains, tiny cracks and sparse chips exposing pale limestone, low broad contrast, no yellow/brown blotches or bricks; no perspective, shadows, objects or text. Strong base/rain weathering supplied separately by engine masks. Requested2048; actual returned dimensions recorded.
